answer: To resist sybils each agent must compute a sequential memory-hard proof of its private delta state each epoch, requiring about 40 serial seconds of non-parallelizable RAM work. A shared grove of encrypted probe challenges demands unique cipher responses; matching fingerprints across identities trigger joint stake slash of the whole cluster. A 150-clone farm therefore burns 150 times the compute and risks total collateral loss on any collision, while a single honest agent pays only its own sequential cost
